outputs.bodyEnglish: Mentioned in the preceding [one], if established; and it will come in the biography of 'Abd Allah bin As'ad bin Zurarah that some of them narrated the hadith mentioned in his biography, saying: from 'Abd Allah bin As'ad bin Zurarah, from his father; so perhaps in it [the name] was bin As'ad. He said: and this is this 'Abd Allah.

It is said he is the name of the grandfather of Raja' bin Haywa; said by Ahmad bin Muhammad bin al-Hajjaj bin Rushdin. And al-Tabarani narrated via the route of Jariya bin Mus'ab from Raja' bin Haywa from his father from his grandfather, and he is among the companions of the Prophet ﷺ, [narrating] that a captive from the spoils of Hunayn passed by the Prophet ﷺ, and he said, "Whose is this?" [the Hadith], and he did not name his grandfather. And Ibn 'Asakir reported two other opinions regarding him: one of them is Jandal with a nun then a dal, and the other is with a zay instead of the dal.
outputs.titleEnglish: Jarwal bin al-Ahnaf bin al-Samt bin Imru' al-Qays bin 'Amr bin Mu'awiya bin al-Harith al-Akbar al-Kindi

outputs.bodyEnglish: Ibn al-Kalbi, Ibn Sa'd, and al-Tabari mentioned that he had a delegation. And Ibn al-Athir said: In the Dhayl Abi Musa, [it is] al-Harith bin Qarra with a Qaf, and that which is in al-Jamhara is Farwa with a Fa' and an additional Waw, and that is the correct [version]. And [he] said that his grandfather al-Shaytan was named so because of his beauty.
outputs.titleEnglish: Al-Harith bin Farwa bin al-Shaytan bin Khadij bin Imru' al-Qays bin al-Harith bin Mu'awiya bin al-Harith bin Mu'awiya bin Thawr al-Kindi
